mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces the discount rate applied to future cash flows, increasing the present value of expected equity returns and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a flight to quality in equities, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) reduces consumer purchasing power, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising benefits periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) increases consumer purchasing power, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling benefits periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend signals weakening aggregate demand, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in INDPRO weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above trend signals a recovery in aggregate demand, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in HOUST weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in HOUST strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
